test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All trojans are fairies.

No fairy is a flower.

All viruses are trojans.

**Conclusions:**

I. No flower is a trojan.

II. Some viruses are trojans.

III. No trojan is a virus.

options.text: Only conclusion I and III follow
Only conclusion I and II follow

solution:
Given Statements:

All trojans are fairies.

No fairy is a flower.

All viruses are trojans.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/273aef17f63db5022ee6df6d82a32c96d500c5c04252cf9adaeed388e970be33.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No flower is a trojan - True (Because, All trojans are part of fairy, and no fairy is flower).

II. Some viruses are trojans - True (Because, All viruses are trojans, it also gives some virus are trojans).

III. No trojan is a virus - False (Because, All viruses are trojans).

So, Only conclusion I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
